content.thinking: The test sleeps 100ms and then checks expiry against SystemTime::now(). Under load the sleep can return before the TTL boundary is crossed relative to the lease's own clock read.

content.text: The flake comes from the test sleeping for exactly the TTL and comparing against the real wall clock. I will inject a ManualClock into Lease so the test advances time deterministically instead of sleeping.

input.command: for i in $(seq 1 50); do cargo test -q lease_expires_after_ttl || break; done
